title: Jesus didn’t come for perfect people.
paragraphs: Jesus didn’t come for perfect people.
He came for the ones who feel too broken to be loved.

For the sinner.
For the ashamed.
For the one who thinks their past disqualified them.
It’s the very reason He came.
If you feel unworthy today, remember this:
You are the kind of person Jesus came to rescue.

His grace is bigger than your past.
His mercy is deeper than your shame.
